snippet.title: Extraction Shop Simulator Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Extraction Shop Simulator: You're the vendor. They go into the Zone. You get rich either way. A first-person shop/management sim set on the edge of the Chernobyl exclusion zone. Inspired by the tone of Extraction Shooters but from the other side of the counter.
